<sql>SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN "AcceptedAnswerId" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS acceptance_rate
FROM main."posts"
WHERE "PostTypeId" = 1
  AND "CreaionDate" >= '2010-12-01'
  AND "CreaionDate" < '2011-01-01'
  AND "CreaionDate" < '2011-02-01';</sql>
